Restrictions on dissemination of under-review work are a small but necessary price to pay to protect the integrity of the peer review process. My research interests include core NLP topics such as syntax, semantics, pragmatics, and discourse. Do you agree or disagree with the following claim about the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), as of 2022? Author anonymity during review is valuable enough to warrant restrictions on the dissemination of research that is under review.

 (A) Agree
